response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM MediaType AS m JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM per_type) SELECT AVG(p.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(p.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(p.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_margin FROM per_type AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.rate > o.average_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A media type’s rate is total bytes divided by total milliseconds for its tracks with known Bytes. All its tracks count toward the track total.

alternatives.interpretation: A media type’s rate is the simple average of its individual tracks’ bytes-per-millisecond rates.
